translatorNotes: FLAG — LEGAL-ETHICS JURISDICTION SENSITIVITY: this post draws the line between what an intake agent may do (gather facts, confirm matter types, schedule consultations) and what it must not do (give legal advice, assess case strength). It references unauthorized practice of law, attorney handoff/escalation, and client confidentiality/privilege. These duties differ by jurisdiction (US state bars, EU/LATAM bar rules). A qualified legal reviewer in the target market must confirm the Spanish wording does not overstate what automation may do or imply legal advice. 'Unauthorized practice of law' rendered as 'ejercicio no autorizado de la abogacía'; 'privilege/confidentiality' rendered as 'secreto profesional/confidencialidad' — both concepts are jurisdiction-sensitive and require legal review.

Legal glossary applied consistently: client intake → admisión de clientes / admisión; law firm → bufete (with 'despacho' used where natural, and in the fixed term 'sistema de gestión del despacho'); attorney → abogado; matter/case → asunto/caso; conflicts → conflictos / revisión de conflictos; consultation → consulta; legal advice → asesoría legal; confidentiality → confidencialidad; retainer/retained client → encargo / cliente contratado. 'Clio' kept as-is.
Register: informal tú throughout. No em-dashes used anywhere (mdash entities kept only inside the data table as en-dash-style placeholders matching the English source's — empty cells).

Kept exact: numbers/percentages (33%, 40%, 48%, 56%, 73%, 42 por ciento), read-time (9 min de lectura), date (27 de julio de 2026 / Julio 2026 style), brand/tool names (Clio, Twilio, Calendly, n8n, Make, Clio Legal Trends Report), acronym API, 'Innovaria Tech Limited', email info@innovariatech.space, phone +1 601 860 1258. Currency: '$1,000 and $5,000' → '1.000 y 5.000 dólares'; '$50 to $300' → '50 a 300 dólares'.
